name: Levimur, Elder (Lupice)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
Lupice CR 15

XP 51,200
CN Medium magical beast (cold)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +28
Aura confusion (10 ft., DC 25)

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 15, flat-footed 28 (+5 Dex, +18 natural)
hp 199 (21d10+84)
Fort +16, Ref +17, Will +13
DR 10/cold iron; Immune cold, fire, paralysis, sleep; SR 27

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +26 (1d8+10/19-20 plus trip), 2 claws +29 (1d8+7/19- 20 plus rend)
Special Attacks breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 12d10 cold, DC 25, usable every 1d4 rounds), rend (2 claws, 1d8+10)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 21st)

At will—ray of frost
3/day—confusion (DC 19), deeper darkness, mirror image, silent image (DC 16), vanish

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 20, Con 19, Int 21, Wis 19, Cha 20
Base Atk +21; CMB +26; CMD 41 (45 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness, Critical Focus, Improved Critical (bite, claw), Improved Natural Weapon (claw), Iron Will, Power Attack, Quicken Spell, Stunning Critical, Vital Strike
Skills Appraise +29, Bluff +32, Intimidate +29, Knowledge (arcana) +29, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Spellcraft +29; Racial Modifiers +4 Bluff
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Orcish
SQ trainer spells (CL 10th)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Confusion (Su)

As the spell. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by that lupice’s aura of confusion for one day. Other levimurs are immune to the lupice’s aura of confusion. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ABOUT

The natives of the frozen lands within the Kingdom treat lupice as a spirit guide and trickster who punishes mischievous deeds with its cursed bite. Children are warned not to misbehave, lest the lupice comes for them in the night and brings them into its pack.

Researchers who have studied the lupice in its natural environment have connected its bite to an otherwise rare illness, but all agree that the monster cannot actually transform others into its kind.
